meta.title: KMCODE — Private, supported smart home installation
meta.description: KMCODE installs your smart home: lighting, heating, smart cameras, voice assistant. Your data stays at home, no mandatory subscription.
meta.offersDescription: Smart home installation packages from €490 to €1,190, hardware at retail price, Serenity support from €19/month with no commitment.

hero.subtitle: Lighting, heating, cameras, voice assistant: KMCODE installs, configures and looks after your smart home. Your data stays at home, and nothing forces you to subscribe.

problem.title: Fewer chores, lower bills, more peace of mind.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.text: Lights, heating and moods follow your habits. One word or one tap, and the whole house adapts.

savings.title: Savings
savings.text: Heating adjusts to your presence, and you finally see, every day, where your energy goes.

security.title: Peace of mind
security.text: Someone at the door? You get a notification with a photo, wherever you are.

solutions.title: Everything your home can do for you
solutions.subtitle: Start with the essentials, then add more whenever you like. Everything is controlled from one place.

lighting.title: Lighting and moods
lighting.text: Lights that turn on when you arrive, "evening" or "leaving" scenes, everything off in one tap.

climate.title: Heating and energy
climate.text: Room-by-room heating, open-window alerts, daily energy tracking.

cameras.title: Smart cameras
cameras.text: They recognise a person, alert you with an image and record at home, not in a cloud.

voice.title: Voice assistant
voice.text: "Turn everything off except the living room", "is it cold in the bedroom?": your home answers.

tablet.title: Wall tablet
tablet.text: A wall-mounted screen to see and control the whole house at a glance, for the whole family.

remote.title: App and remote access
remote.text: Your home in your pocket, securely, without opening anything on your internet router.

plans.title: Clear packages, hardware included in the quote
plans.subtitle: A fixed installation fee, hardware at retail price, and optional support. You know exactly what you pay for.

essential.name: Essential
features: Home automation hub installed and configured
A custom dashboard and the mobile app
1 hour of hands-on training with you
essential.hardwareText: Home hub and wireless connection key

comfort.name: Comfort
comfort.tagline: The whole house, controlled by touch or by voice.
comfort.hardwareText: Powerful hub, wireless key, wall tablet, voice assistant

vigilance.name: Vigilance
vigilance.tagline: Cameras that understand what they see.
features: Detects people and certain sounds (baby crying)
Notification with a photo on your phone
vigilance.hardwareText: Cameras of your choice, on the powerful hub (included in Comfort)

method.title: From first chat to smart home

audit.title: Assessment
audit.text: On site or by video call, we review your needs and devices. €79, deducted if you order.

proposal.title: Detailed quote
proposal.text: The right package and the hardware list, at retail price. You can also buy it yourself.

install.title: Installation and training
install.text: We install, set up your everyday scenes and show you how to use everything.

handover.title: Support, if you want it
handover.text: With the Serenity subscription, we look after your installation. Without it, everything keeps working.

privacy.title: Your home is yours, and so is your data
privacy.text: Everything runs at home, on your hub. Our commitments are written into the contract.

home.title: Everything stays at home
home.text: History, settings and videos stay on your hub. Nothing goes to a cloud without your consent.

cameras.title: Your images are yours
cameras.text: We commit to never viewing your cameras. Every maintenance connection we make is logged.

owner.title: You are the owner
owner.text: Of the hardware, accounts, passwords and data. You can cut our access at any time.

leave.title: Free to leave
leave.text: When the contract ends, we hand everything over and delete our copies within 30 days.

brands.title: Works with the devices you already have
brands.text: Appliances, speakers, robot vacuum, heating, lighting: we connect your brands together, without locking you into any of them.

subscription.a: No. Your installation works without a subscription and you keep everything. Serenity adds monitoring, updates and remote troubleshooting, with no commitment.

hardware.a: Your choice: we supply it at retail price, or you buy it yourself from the list we give you. Either way, it belongs to you.

works.a: Usually not: most devices are wireless. If your project involves the fuse box or in-wall modules, a partner insured electrician handles it, quoted separately.

internet.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
internet.a: Your home keeps working normally, because everything runs locally. Only remote access pauses during the outage.

alarm.q: Do the cameras replace an alarm?
alarm.a: No. They detect and alert you, but they don't replace a certified alarm recognised by insurers. We don't sell alarms or monitoring services.

ai.a: It's optional and off by default. If you turn it on (a smarter voice assistant, camera alerts described in one sentence), it runs on your own account, for a few euros a month paid directly to the provider.

cta.title: Let's talk about your home
cta.text: Tell us about your project: we'll offer an assessment and a clear quote.

offers.title: Clear prices, no surprises
offers.subtitle: You pay a fixed installation fee, hardware at retail price and, only if you want it, a monthly support plan with no commitment.

labor.title: A fixed installation fee
labor.text: Installation, setup, dashboard and training. A fixed price, known in advance.

hardware.title: Hardware at retail price
hardware.text: We supply it at retail price, or you buy it yourself from our list. It belongs to you.

care.title: Optional support
care.text: The Serenity subscription looks after your installation. No commitment, cancel any month.

diagnostic.title: It all starts with an assessment
diagnostic.text: On site or by video call, we list your devices and wishes, then hand you a detailed quote.

offers.hardwareSubtitle: Well-known hardware, chosen for reliability. Prices observed in November 2026, reviewed with each quote.

boxSimple.name: Home hub
boxSimple.text: The brain of the house, for the Essential plan. Compact and silent.

boxPro.name: Powerful hub
boxPro.text: More powerful: required for smart cameras and the voice assistant.

radio.name: Wireless connection key
radio.text: Lets the hub talk to connected sensors, bulbs and plugs.

voice.name: Voice assistant
voice.text: A small speaker that listens for its wake word, without recording your conversations.

tablet.name: Wall tablet
tablet.text: Wall-mounted, screen off at night, built to stay plugged in permanently.

cameraIndoor.name: Indoor camera
cameraIndoor.text: Discreet, Wi-Fi, to keep an eye on a room.

cameraPtz.name: Pan-tilt camera
cameraPtz.text: It rotates to cover a whole room, controlled from your phone.

cameraOutdoor.name: Outdoor camera
cameraOutdoor.text: High definition, weatherproof, powered through its cable.

doorbell.name: Video doorbell
doorbell.text: See who's ringing, with a photo on your phone.

aiVoice.name: Smart voice assistant
aiVoice.text: Talk to your home naturally, with custom commands.

aiCameras.name: Described camera alerts
aiCameras.text: "A courier is leaving a parcel at the door" instead of "motion detected".

extraDevice.name: Extra device
extraDevice.text: Beyond the number included in your plan.

hour.name: Hour of work
hour.text: For any request outside your plan.

offers.aiNote: AI add-ons are turned on by you and run on your own account: a few euros a month, paid directly to the provider.
